items.html: And since they are lights superior to Ima, therefore they have the power to draw that brain of Daat upward into the head, even though its root is from the two shoulders of Arich Anpin, which are from the aspect of VAK of the body. But in the Nukva of ZA, whose Keter is from the Tifferet of ZA alone, there is no power to raise it upward into her head, since its root is from the aspect of the body. Therefore her Daat remains below, between her two shoulders, as stated in its place.
